harness: One API request per batch of up to 10 trials: one user message holding the round's instructions unchanged and the batch's packets; no system prompt, no tools, no web. Every response is saved with the model and provider that served it (OpenAI for all). The subgroup block is left out: in one trial the model gave a ratio range starting at 0, which the checker refuses, in all three runs of its batch.
run_settings: Reasoning effort xhigh, max 100,000 output tokens; 66 batches. 35 batches dropped by the provider (not billed) were sent again. Re-runs: 1 batch, twice (subgroup ratio of 0; not cleared).
